decks.notes: The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to control the board through the use of lands like Wasteland and Ancient Tomb while also taking advantage of cards like Eye of Ugin to cheat out big creatures like Reality Smasher. By utilizing mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Grim Monolith, this deck is able to quickly establish a dominant board presence and close out the game with aggressive attacks.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back into play for a powerful advantage. The deck relies on a strong balance of card draw, counterspells, and disruption to protect its combo pieces and control the game. With Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty as key threats, supported by Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Atraxa, Grand Unifier for additional value, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and game-changing plays.

The main focus of this deck is to use the combo of Show and Tell with cards like Sneak Attack and Omniscience to quickly put big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield, overpowering the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces, as well as Force of Will to protect its combo. With strong mana acceleration from Lotus Petal and City of Traitors, the deck aims to win the game quickly by getting powerful creatures into play faster than the opponent can respond.

This deck focuses on using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield. The key concept revolves around setting up a combination of cards that allows for explosive plays, often bypassing traditional methods of playing creatures. Utilizing powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats they are unprepared to handle. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will helps protect the combo pieces and ensure its success.

This Aggro Dragon Stompy deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void while applying pressure with fast creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyroloyfs. The deck also has access to burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to clear the way for attacks. The deck utilizes fast mana sources like Chrome Mox, City of Traitors, and Ancient Tomb to quickly deploy threats and control the board. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for artifacts like Chalice of the Void.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Key cards like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier can swing the game in your favor once they hit the board. Protecting your combo pieces with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, while disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland, is crucial for success in this fast-paced combo-reanimator deck.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures through cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. The deck runs a mix of creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Murktide Regent, along with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brazen Borrower provide versatility in dealing with various threats. The deck aims to control the game early on before assembling its combo pieces for a swift victory.

The main concept of this tempo Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board using powerful spells like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze and Wasteland. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent provide strong threats on the board, supported by card advantage from Mishra's Bauble. The deck aims to maintain tempo advantage through efficient plays and disruption, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggression and control.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's board and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Dress Down. The deck also utilizes card draw and card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain a consistent game plan. Additionally, the deck has a strong win condition with Thundertrap Trainer and Flame of Anor to close out the game quickly once the opponent's threats have been neutralized. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements while also including hate cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on using ramping lands like Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly generate mana and control the board with powerful artifacts and spells. It aims to reach high amounts of mana quickly to play big threats like Emrakul and Ulamog. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain control of the game. By efficiently ramping up mana and controlling the battlefield, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful threats and disruptive elements.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then use spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Wasteland and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will help control the game, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm provide card advantage and consistency. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to overwhelm opponents with powerful reanimated threats.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing lands as resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy. It focuses on cycling through the deck with Life from the Loam and efficiently tutoring lands with Crop Rotation and Expedition Map. The key strategy revolves around utilizing lands such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to quickly create a powerful 20/20 creature, while also utilizing disruptive elements like Wasteland and Karakas to control the pace of the game. Boseiju, Who Endures adds resilience to the deck by making key spells uncounterable, providing a strong control and combo matchup.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's plays. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card selection and filtering, while Murktide Regent provides a strong threat in the air. The deck aims to combo off and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for an explosive combo finish. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the opponent's game plan, while utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and resilience, with key lands like Wasteland and Underground Sea supporting the overall strategy.

The focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void. The deck also aims to ramp up its mana production with cards like Ancient Tomb and Eye of Ugin to cast its threats ahead of schedule. By applying early pressure and utilizing disruptive elements, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Cabal Therapy, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing the combo of reanimating creatures such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures early in the game. The inclusion of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask helps to protect the combo and ensure a swift victory through powerful creature recursion.
